units.source_text: “喀拉克斯党的领袖是著名政治家啰培。

en.t: The leader of the Karax Party is the famous politician Lope.

units.source_text: 俾斯麦以前说过‘诚实是最好的外交’吗？

en.t: Did Bismarck once say, 'Honesty is the best diplomacy'?

units.source_text: 然而啰培把诚实也运用到内政上面了……”

en.t: However, Lope applied honesty to domestic politics as well..."
